subject: MedHealth compliance follow-up — residency & export-control checks
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Bethany Cruz <bethany.cruz@medhealth.com>; security@medhealth.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: MedHealth compliance follow-up — residency & export-control checks

Hi Bethany / MedHealth security team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — useful discussion and great context on the regulatory constraints for MedHealth. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) SOC 2 / security posture
- You mentioned SOC 2 Type II is a requirement for procurement. Redwood has an in-progress Type II audit (expected Q2 finish). I'll attach our short SOC 2 summary and the anticipated timeline.

2) Data residency & cross-border transfers
- Primary ask: EU data residency for patient-related processing and strict controls on any cross-border transfers (we heard no transfers to non-EU without explicit contractual and technical safeguards).
- Action: We're validating EU region availability and private-deployment options (VPC / on-prem) that can meet your contract rules.

3) HIPAA / BAAs
- You flagged HIPAA applicability and the need for a BAA. We'll draft a standard BAA and share it for your legal review.

4) Export controls (OFAC / ITAR)
- You also asked about export-control checks given some vendors can have restricted data flows. We'll run the compliance checklist and confirm whether any OFAC/ITAR constraints create issues for EU-hosted deployments.

5) Vendor security questionnaire
- If you can send the vendor questionnaire (or the DocuSign / portal link) we will triage it and return answers within the SLA below.

Proposed timeline:
- 48–72h: acknowledge receipt of vendor questionnaire and identify any blocking items.
- 5 business days: return completed vendor questionnaire + SOC 2 summary + prelim answers on residency/BAA/ITAR.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary), redwood-eu-deployment-brief.pdf (capabilities & options)

If that works, please send the questionnaire and any additional compliance contacts (legal/infosec) to include on thread.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns with our notes. I'm attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire; it has a few HITRUST/HIPAA-specific sections plus export-control flags (Q33–Q42) that our procurement team uses to screen for cross-border risk.

Key priorities for us:
- EU residency guarantee for processing/hosting patient data (we can accept dedicated VPC in eu-west if there's no replication outside region).
- Signed BAA before any PHI exchange.
- Clear statement on export-control screening: we need to know whether Redwood performs OFAC screening on customer account metadata and whether any models or artifacts are deployed from sources that would be restricted under ITAR.

We'll expect a triaged response within 5 business days. If you need any clarifications on the questionnaire items, ping me or Oliver (copied).

Attachment: MedHealth_Vendor_Sec_Q.pdf

Regards,
Bethany Cruz
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager | MedHealth Systems

Tessa / team — forwarding Bethany's questionnaire (attached) and drafting a short action list so we can respond cleanly: 

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Rishi: Validate SOC 2 Type II timeline and confirm whether any controls will be materially different for hosted vs private deployments. ETA: 48h.
- Karthik: Confirm EU region availability & technical constraints (is dedicated VPC deployable in eu-west/auto region pin?). Also check replication defaults and whether we can guarantee no replication to non-EU. ETA: 3 business days.
- Monica (Legal ops): Draft BAA_Draft.docx and flag any negotiated clauses for MedHealth. ETA: 3 business days.
- Tessa: Return completed vendor questionnaire to Bethany and propose meeting if there are outstanding open controls. ETA: 5 business days.

Export-control note: Bethany called out OFAC/ITAR screening. This looks like two levels: (1) OFAC screening of customer identity/metadata (we do basic identity checks today — need to confirm process and retention); (2) ITAR concerns if MedHealth workflows include devices with controlled technical data. Karthik, can you surface any model- or artifact-sourcing that might trigger ITAR? If we can't disqualify, we'll refer to Legal.

I'll prepare the SOC 2 summary and a short Q&A mapping so Tessa can fill the questionnaire faster. Reply-all for any blocker.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Bethany — thanks for sending the questionnaire and for the call last week. Quick preliminary responses inline (high level) and attachments below. We'll follow up with the completed questionnaire in the requested SLA window.

Q: EU residency guarantee
A: Redwood can provide an EU-dedicated deployment (eu-west region) via our Private offering (dedicated VPC). By default hosted instances are multi-region to improve reliability, but for regulated workloads we offer region-pin options and guaranteed non-replication outside the selected region. (See attached: redwood-eu-deployment-brief.pdf)

Q: SOC 2
A: We are mid-audit for SOC 2 Type II with the audit period covering 2025; report expected Q2 2026. In the meantime, we've attached a short SOC 2 controls summary and our interim self-attestation for key controls.

Q: HIPAA / BAA
A: We can sign a BAA. I've attached an initial BAA_Draft.docx for your legal team to review — happy to iterate.

Q: OFAC / ITAR screening
A: 
- OFAC: Redwood performs identity screening at contract on-boarding; we do not perform automated OFAC checks against runtime request payloads. If required, we can add account-level screening and update lists used during provisioning.
- ITAR: Our engineering team confirms that none of our core public models include ITAR-controlled technical data. However, if MedHealth plans to ingest or host ITAR-controlled material (e.g., technical specs tied to defense systems), we would need to evaluate and potentially use air-gapped deployments and coordinate with Legal.

Next steps:
- We will complete the questionnaire and return it within 5 business days.
- Rishi will provide the SOC 2 timeline and any control evidence we can share pre-report.
- Tessa will share the DocuSign/HubSpot record when we upload the completed questionnaire.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (interim controls), redwood-eu-deployment-brief.pdf, BAA_Draft.docx

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
